categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Hengerda New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent CNC equipment and its core working and functional components. The main product lines include metal cutting tools (such as die-cutting tools and sawing tools), intelligent CNC equipment (including CNC automatic circular saws, high-speed CNC band saws, flexible material intelligent cutting machines, and CNC machining centers), and rolling functional components (mainly linear guideways).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages nearly 30 years of expertise in metal materials and heat treatment technologies, including innovative microstructure design and synchronous isothermal quenching. It has developed proprietary alloy compositions and automated specialized equipment for production. The manufacturing process integrates digital automatic control technology to ensure high precision, efficiency, and product stability, with automated production lines for die-cutting and bi-metal band saw blades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from diverse industries including light industry manufacturing, equipment manufacturing, automotive, electronics, aerospace, military, nuclear power, rail transit, and high-end medical sectors. The company serves both large manufacturing enterprises and numerous small to medium-sized enterprises, with a significant presence in domestic markets and expanding international sales to over 50 countries including Russia, Vietnam, India, Turkey, Brazil, and Mexico.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, headquartered in Putian City, Fujian Province, with sales covering major domestic industrial regions such as the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta. It also has a growing international footprint with exports to more than 50 countries across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Hengerda operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing core working components (metal cutting tools) and functional components (rolling functional parts) for intelligent CNC equipment, which are essential inputs for downstream industrial machinery and manufacturing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product series development and integrated equipment solutions, focusing on expanding intelligent CNC equipment and rolling functional components. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with academic and research institutions to develop high-strength, high-toughness materials, advanced heat treatment processes, and high-precision linear guideways. Key R&D projects include high-performance die-cutting steels, hard alloy band saw blades, and heavy-load rolling guideways, aiming to enhance product performance and achieve import substitution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal cutting tools, intelligent CNC equipment, and rolling functional components. The company employs a sales model dominated by distribution channels complemented by direct sales, with increasing emphasis on direct sales for strategic customers and overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position domestically, especially in heavy die-cutting tools and bi-metal band saw blades, recognized as a manufacturing champion in Fujian Province. It competes with international giants in rolling functional components such as THK, NSK, and HIWIN, while actively working to reduce import dependence and improve domestic market share through technological advancements and product quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 585 million, representing a 7.88% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.3 million, stable compared to the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 1.48 billion, with steady growth in both revenue and profitability. The company continues to expand its production capacity and market reach, particularly in emerging business segments like intelligent CNC equipment and rolling functional components.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fujian Hengerda emphasizes its nearly three decades of expertise in metal materials and heat treatment, proprietary technologies, and automated production capabilities to deliver high-strength, high-toughness, and long-life metal cutting tools. Its comprehensive product matrix and integrated equipment solutions provide customers with one-stop procurement and tailored cutting solutions. The company’s products meet or exceed international standards, offering superior performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness, which enhances customer loyalty and repeat purchases.
